notes.title: v1.0.1.7
notes.content:
- Game is updated to Unreal Engine 4.25

- Game is no longer supported on Windows 32 bit. It's only available for Windows 64 bit.

- Game can't start on some players - "Steam Library" with "Play" button.

- Fences on the levels are much more easy to be dropped. Their "Life" is reduced. But this not apply for the special levels like a: Forest 3, Snow 3, Desert 3...

- In Single Player by default are used 3 opponents, but of course this can be changed with "Opponents" button.

- In Single Player, the chat window is not showing up anymore... obviously there is no one to chat with :)

- In Online mode when the maximum Wins are reached (for example 3/3), then all players are returned back to Lobby screen automatically.

- With Gamepad right thumbstick button is used to focus on game menus (in case you lost buttons focus).

- Main buttons have a little change on the style - in game menu.

- Minor bug fixes
